summary.headline: August funnel numbers are inflated by a bulk import; win rate jumped to 85% even as revenue cooled for the season.
summary.body: HIH (52) and MQL (281) more than doubled MoM, but nearly 80% of new contacts arrived via an offline bulk import, not organic demand — SQL (126, +12.5%) and Opportunities (124, +9.7%) are the more reliable read. Revenue fell to $149.6K across 34 deals as the spring-summer district buying peak tapered into the August lull, but win rate improved sharply to 85% (from 56%), so deal quality held even as deal size shrank. MQA accounts stand at 12 in the buy window.

brand_lift.note: These are Google Search numbers, not social engagement — how often our brand and channels surface when people search. YouTube and Instagram are Search Console platform properties, visible in the Search Console UI but not exposed by the Search Analytics API, so those tiles stay blank rather than showing a fabricated zero. LinkedIn has no GSC connector — it's owned by Microsoft and isn't integrated with Google. ⏳ The week of Aug 24 is still provisional: Google has finalized only 5 of its 7 days, so its full-week total (234 branded clicks) is understated and will revise upward on the next run. The WoW figure shown compares the same 5 settled days in each week, which is the like-for-like read; the full-week comparison would be misleading until the week settles.

current.narrative: This week's signal is a tale of two funnel halves: top-of-funnel strengthened meaningfully, with 16 High Intent Handraisers [HIH] entering — double last week's pace — and MQL volume held at 56, essentially flat. The lower funnel tells a different story: SQL entries dropped to 13 (from 33) and Opportunities to 12 (from 33), both at their lowest point in the trailing five weeks. The pattern is consistent with W34 pull-forward — end-of-month acceleration moved lifecycle entries that would otherwise have distributed into W35, so the dip is expected rather than alarming. Watch for SQL to recover toward 25–30 next week as the pipeline refills from this week's HIH surge.

previous.narrative: Back-to-school surge normalized: MQL -30% and HIH -43% vs. last week’s peak. SQL and Opp strengthened to 33 each (+10%/+14%), showing the W33 inbound class converting well mid-funnel. Inkwell led with 15 MQLs; IJ had 8. Pipeline holds at 29 district / 17 school open deals. DQ and Nurture returned to normal levels (64/18 vs. 246/182 last week).
